name: Busabase
description: Busabase is the system of record for AI agents — an open-source (MIT) database and workspace where agents and people share the same data, docs, skills, and apps. Every change keeps its history, and the writes that matter can wait for a person to review. Connects to the hosted Busabase MCP endpoint using OAuth 2.1 (browser sign-in, no API key to paste).
